newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa ends down, held down by New York.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa ends down, held down by New York.

text.p: LIFFE cocoa ended lower on Tuesday after being kept in check by a lacklustre New York market, traders said.

Benchmark September, which took a look below 1,000 stg resistance during morning trade, scored a low of 994 stg. It last traded 12 stg lower at 1,001, accounting for 828 of the total 2,968 lots traded.
But September was outdone in volume terms by December, with 1,161 lots. December last traded 11 stg lower at 1,033 stg.
Traders described the London market as fundamentally flat and directionless. "We are seeing a lot of speculative selling in New York which is keeping the London market in check," one trader said.
Funds selling long positions in New York were keeping London in check, he said.
Cocoa slumped in early morning trade in New York, with September briefly dipping below chart support at $1,490/tonne.
